items.title: SEC Crypto Custody Rewrite Enters White House Review
items.summary: The planned rule would cover advisers and investment companies and clarify digital-asset custody, following the withdrawal of a separate 2023 proposal.

items.title: X Sues Two Bitcoin Influencers Over Bot Army That Milked Creator Payouts
items.summary: A lawsuit accuses UK users of running six coordinated accounts to pull at least $278,000 from X's now-defunct Creator Revenue Sharing Program.

items.title: Crypto political group plans to spend $30 million against Sherrod Brown's Senate bid
